positions.title: Lead Engineer: Fullstack Developer
positions.description:
–Provided development work on a US Army web application by:
* Leading an agile scrum team to develop features and updates over a 4 week sprint
* Implementing new features in a React, Redux and Java code base
* Identifying code and process defects and providing solutions
* Working closely with the project owner, QA team, and a focus group to gather requirements
* Engaging in code reviews and architecture designs to improve the overall application
– From October 2017 to February 2019, provided support on a SPAWAR 4.0 web application by:
* Implementing new features upon an existing JSP, Struts, and Oracle DB code base
* Creating UI mockups to be put into the requirement document
* Updating the code base to comply with Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG)

projects.title: Transparent Legislature Project
projects.description:
Made a series of prototypes for a California Assembly member.  The goal of the prototypes was to evaluate audio transcription services for extracting data from videos of conferences; the overall goal of the project was to provide transparency in the California government by hosting a database of information about all meetings held, allowing citizens to remotely access their transcripts/recordings easily.

Results were given in the form of a white paper detailing each transcription service and a number of evaluation criteria.

projects.title: Happy Cabbage Adventure
projects.description: Happy Cabbage Adventure is a 2.5D platforming game written in C++ using OpenGL. It was a class project starting off with six members, and later becoming five. Four of the members on the team, myself included, used Happy Cabbage Adventure as their senior project. The project borrowed many ideas from Mario and megaman games, including enemy-specific AI and power-ups. Each member of the team had specific duties in the team. My main job was the project's modeler and character designer. I drew concept art and used Blender for modeling.
